title: census.py apply writes no census.phase ops row, so phase 2's outcomes are never measured
goal: census.py apply writes a census.phase ops row whose phase is apply, in the closed shape kb/_self/querylog.md names

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base
home = tempfile.mkdtemp()
env = bl_base.check_env(os.getcwd(), home)
log = os.path.join(home, '2026-10-21.csv')
open(log, 'w').write('id,url,kind,repo,pin,path,retrieved_utc,http_status,bucket,evidence,proof,note,used_in,outcome,outcome_note\n')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/census.py', 'apply', log, '--group', 'g1', '--from', os.path.join(home, 'none.json')],
                   env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
rows = []
for d, _, fs in os.walk(home):
    for f in fs:
        if f.endswith('.jsonl'):
            rows += [l for l in open(os.path.join(d, f), encoding='utf-8') if '"census.phase"' in l and '"apply"' in l]
print('apply exit', p.returncode, 'census.phase apply rows', len(rows))
sys.exit(0 if rows else 1)
